game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Archery Yard, the garrison archery yard: the knight must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute keys without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Archery Yard: the garrison archery yard
core_gameplay_loop: In Archery Yard, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute keys without losing either value. Each round, shadow scouts strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the a value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from shadow scouts in Archery Yard: keep the a meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: a drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
